name: Fincept MCP
tagline: Hosted MCP for Fincept Terminal: market data, economics, filings, backtests and 15 quant engines.
description: Hosted MCP server for Fincept Terminal with 440 platform tools and 15 quant engines: market quotes, OHLCV candles, option chains, futures curves, fundamentals and symbol search; global economic series and SEC filings; news, sentiment and alternative data; portfolio analytics, screeners and strategy backtests; the Fincept Paper trading account (no real money); and engines for statistics, forecasting, GARCH volatility, panel econometrics, technical indicators, regimes, copulas, portfolio optimisation and fixed-income/derivatives pricing. Sign in once through the browser with OAuth 2.1. Requires the paid Exclusive Pro plan.
